# @erdflow/prisma

> Interactive ERD from a Prisma schema. Opens http://127.0.0.1:4317/

## Run

```bash
npx @erdflow/prisma
npx @erdflow/prisma --prisma ./prisma/schema.prisma
npx @erdflow/prisma --prisma ./prisma/schema
npx @erdflow/prisma --prisma ./backend/prisma/schema.prisma
npx @erdflow/prisma --prisma ./prisma/schema.prisma --port 5000
npx @erdflow/prisma --prisma ./prisma/schema.prisma --no-open
npx @erdflow/prisma --prisma ./prisma/schema.prisma --no-watch
```

Binary after install: `erdflow-prisma`. Requires Node.js ≥ 20.

Supports Prisma v6 and v7 (multi-file, `prisma.config.ts`).

## Providers

- SQL (postgresql, mysql, sqlite, …) → ERD + SQL View
- mongodb → Document View (ObjectId / collections)

## Agent instructions

Read **AGENTS.md** in this package for Prisma detection, monorepo pitfalls, and UI expectations.

## Files in this package

- README.md — human overview + screenshots
- AGENTS.md — Prisma instructions for AI agents
- llms.txt — this index
- media/prisma-erd.png — ERD canvas
- media/prisma-focus.png — focused table

## Family

Other domains (e.g. Laravel) will be separate packages (`@erdflow/laravel`, …), not this one.
